findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_campaign" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.detail: Tool "list_coupons" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_setup_status, update_affiliate_status, check_tracking, search · Private data: switch_from_another_tool, update_campaign, list_campaigns, create_conversion, search, fetch · Public sink: get_setup_status, update_business, create_campaign, update_campaign, invite_affiliate, update_affiliate_status, get_tracking_instructions, create_conversion · Destructive: check_tracking, update_conversion.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_setup_status, update_affiliate_status, check_tracking, search · Private data: switch_from_another_tool, update_campaign, list_campaigns, create_conversion, search, fetch · Public sink: get_setup_status, update_business, create_campaign, update_campaign, invite_affiliate, update_affiliate_status, get_tracking_instructions, create_conversion · Destructive: check_tracking, update_conversion

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
